mechanism.claim: Within a high-variation completed eight-hour BTC auction, repeated strict running-high discoveries versus running-low discoveries measure which side is actively expanding the accepted range. When that record-discovery breadth is unusually one-sided, follow the dominant discovery direction for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign(running-high discovery count minus running-low discovery count)
mechanism.why_distinct: HVRTR used only the occurrence order of the single absolute daily high and low plus close location. HVRDBR counts every strict sequential range expansion in fixed eight-hour blocks. Donchian and reclaim candidates test one boundary crossing; confirmation ladders use external block ordering. No prior event set or control is reused.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed-block realized-variation causal rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: record-discovery breadth at fixed eight-hour boundaries is absent from Gross9

features.block: 96 exact coherent BTCUSDT perpetual five-minute aggregates in [D-8h,D), each from five unique 1m rows
features.running_high_discovery: for bars 2..96, bar high strictly exceeds every earlier bar high in the block
features.running_low_discovery: for bars 2..96, bar low strictly falls below every earlier bar low in the block
features.breadth: high-discovery count minus low-discovery count; strict nonzero
features.discovery_share: abs(breadth)/(high count+low count), denominator strict positive
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute log(close/open) returns), strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of discovery_share and realized_variation over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 252; current excluded

clock.decision: exact block boundary after all source bars complete
clock.reservation: fixed blocks and holds are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no block, discovery definition, rank, history, threshold, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
